[message_id=681824 author=Ritwika Kancharla first=True]
The causal_conv1d_cuda.so binary in the environment is not compiled 
for SM120 (Blackwell). Getting cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice on every 
training attempt. ptxas chmod fixes the triton issue but causal_conv1d 
still fails. We cannot install a new version because the filesystem is 
read-only and pip has no internet. How are we supposed to fine-tune on 
this GPU?

[message_id=3423926 author=Anton Kratz first=False]
I also run into this exact issue.

[message_id=3422320 author=Adarsh Kumar first=False]
Turn of the internet and then again on then install it worked for me
